name: io.github.Eklavya17/econ-gateway
description: Live, cited U.S. economic data from BLS and FRED: jobs, wages, prices, by state and metro.

environmentVariables.name: FRED_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free FRED API key. Needed for FRED series, FRED search and the release calendar.

environmentVariables.name: BLS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free BLS API key. Raises the BLS limit from 25 to 500 queries a day.

environmentVariables.name: ECON_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to mount, comma-separated: core, wages, regional, compute (default: all).
